data.one_liner: A Dart client library for Google Cloud Firestore database.
data.what_it_does: Provides a complete API for interacting with Google Cloud Firestore, including documents, collections, queries, transactions, batches, and bulk writes. It can be used standalone or with the Firebase Admin SDK.
use_when: You are building a backend or server application in Dart that needs to interact with Google Cloud Firestore.
You are running inside Firebase Functions or using the Firebase Admin SDK and need Firestore access.
avoid_when: You are building a mobile client application using standard Firebase mobile SDKs (use cloud_firestore instead).
strengths: Complete API support for documents, collections, queries, transactions, and enterprise pipeline operations.
Supports connection pooling via HTTP/2 and integrates with Application Default Credentials or service accounts.
weaknesses: Not intended as a direct drop-in replacement for the mobile client-side cloud_firestore package.
data.setup_notes: Requires either Application Default Credentials (e.g., via gcloud auth application-default login or environment variables) or a service account JSON file.

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose cloud_firestore if you are building a client mobile/web app using Firebase plugins rather than server-side or Cloud/Admin integration.
